visual_anatomy.title: A short contrast-led headline puts the desired outcome into one oversized lavender rough-display tag.
visual_anatomy.layout: Two parallel vertical stories compare a bad and a good version of the same high-level event: each begins with a claim card, routes through a cropped analytics screenshot, and ends with a downstream follower-and-revenue outcome card.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Headline → left bad path from claim to screenshot to outcome → right good path from claim to screenshot to outcome → compare the unequal downstream results.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large lightweight headline, rough display emphasis, bold card headers, simple bullets, and screenshot-native dashboard typography retained inside the proof modules.
visual_anatomy.colour: Pink marks the bad side and lavender the good side; both sit on soft matching vertical background washes, while the analytics screenshots retain green interface chips.
visual_anatomy.surface: White title area, vertically split pastel lower field, oversized rounded claim cards, thin routed arrows, cropped interface proof panels, and low soft shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: Two matched evidence paths: framing claim, analytic snapshot, then claimed business consequence.
visual_anatomy.density: Low-to-medium: only a few elements appear, but the arrow sequence makes the intended causal contrast explicit.

motion.observed_state_change: No temporal state: this is a static JPEG source asset.
motion.motion_job: Not applicable; the complete contrast and stated evidence chain must work in one frame.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Understand why the same vanity metric can lead to materially different business relevance.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Hold the top-level event or metric roughly constant, then visibly trace the different context and downstream outcome in parallel so the real decision criterion cannot be missed.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when both paths have comparable definitions and provenance, and distinguish evidence from inference rather than drawing a causal arrow from an unverified screenshot.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the virality framing, business results, analytics screenshots, bad-versus-good labels, vertical split layout, title tag, colour assignment, or arrow route.

claim_boundary.note: The source visibly states impression, follower, and revenue figures. None is independently verified, and matching numeric ID does not confirm the workbook caption or original post pairing.
